    "FUNCTION tr_read_request_with_tasks.",
    "*\"----------------------------------------------------------------------",
    "*\"*\"Lokale Schnittstelle:",
    "*\"       IMPORTING",
    "*\"             VALUE(IV_TRKORR) TYPE  TRKORR",
    "*\"       EXPORTING",
    "*\"             VALUE(ET_REQUEST_HEADERS) TYPE  TRWBO_REQUEST_HEADERS",
    "*\"             VALUE(ET_REQUESTS) TYPE  TRWBO_REQUESTS",
    "*\"       EXCEPTIONS",
    "*\"              INVALID_INPUT",
    "*\"----------------------------------------------------------------------",
    "  DATA: ls_request_header    TYPE trwbo_request_header,",
    "        ls_request           TYPE trwbo_request.",
    "",
    "",
    "  ls_request_header-trkorr = iv_trkorr.",
    "  CALL FUNCTION 'TRINT_READ_REQUEST_HEADER'",
    "       EXPORTING",
    "            iv_read_e070  = 'X'",
    "            iv_read_e07t  = 'X'",
    "            iv_read_e070c = 'X'",
    "            iv_read_e070m = 'X'",
    "       CHANGING",
    "            cs_request    = ls_request_header",
    "       EXCEPTIONS",
    "            OTHERS        = 1.",
    "  IF sy-subrc <> 0.",
    "    current_message_raising invalid_input.",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "",
    "  CLEAR et_request_headers.",
    "  APPEND ls_request_header TO et_request_headers.",
    "",
    "  CALL FUNCTION 'TRINT_FOLLOW_STRKORR_FORWARD'",
    "       CHANGING",
    "            ct_requests = et_request_headers.",
    "  CALL FUNCTION 'TRINT_FOLLOW_STRKORR_BACKWARD'",
    "       CHANGING",
    "            ct_requests = et_request_headers.",
    "",
    "  IF et_requests IS REQUESTED.",
    "    LOOP AT et_request_headers INTO ls_request_header.",
    "      ls_request-h = ls_request_header.",
    "",
    "      CALL FUNCTION 'TR_READ_REQUEST'",
    "           EXPORTING",
    "                iv_read_objs_keys  = 'X'",
    "*               IV_READ_ATTRIBUTES = ' '",
    "           CHANGING",
    "                cs_request         = ls_request",
    "           EXCEPTIONS",
    "                OTHERS             = 1.",
    "      IF sy-subrc <> 0.",
    "        current_message_raising invalid_input.",
    "      ENDIF.",
    "",
    "      APPEND ls_request TO et_requests.",
    "    ENDLOOP.",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "ENDFUNCTION."
  ],

    "      ENDIF.",
